nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Silkfoliant Daily Tri-Acid Smoothing Toner with Mandelic Acid

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin have mixed results: one with dry/oily combination skin found the toner harsh and irritating and went back to glycolic acid, while others with drier skin say it left their face smoother and softer without drying it out further.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no burning or irritation even from their first acid toner, though there is dissent: one reviewer developed a rash the morning after her first use, and another calls it a little harsh and recommends patch-testing on the arm first.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who names combination skin reports the toner left her skin smoother, brighter, and more even after just a few uses without irritating her.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 40 or in their thirties who mention fine lines or early aging report a brighter, more toned complexion and, in one case, visibly diminished fine lines and lightened sun spots after weeks of regular use.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who identifies as normal skin reports the toner improved her texture, helped dissolve dark spots, and left her skin feeling gentle without stripping her natural barrier.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 40 and in their thirties who mention fine lines report a brighter, more toned complexion after several weeks of regular use, with one specifically noting her fine lines looked diminished.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who discuss hydration say the toner leaves skin softer and more hydrated without drying it out, including several surprised by how moisturizing an exfoliating toner could be; a minority describe skin feeling slippery or almost dry once it is fully absorbed, and a few say they need to layer a moisturizer on top to avoid tightness.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report it fading or evening out with regular use, including one whose rosacea-related redness settled after the toner soaked in; one reviewer instead noticed her skin looking slightly rosier and redder after a month of daily use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers who discuss their skin barrier say the toner does not strip it despite the acid content, describing their skin as balanced and moisturized rather than tight or stripped.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers targeting dark spots or discoloration report gradual fading of sun spots and post-acne marks with regular use, though one reviewer specifically says she noticed no change in her discoloration or dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers using the toner for blemishes report fewer breakouts, faster healing, or fading marks within a few weeks; dissent includes a couple who broke out or purged when starting and one with stubborn acne who saw no improvement after three weeks of use.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance noticeable and bothers some users
Leaves a tacky or sticky finish
Pricey relative to the amount provided
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't a huge fan of this toner. My skin type is a mix of dry/oily. I felt this toner was a little harsh, it left my skin red and irritated. I can't imagine using it during the winter. It's lightweight, & doesn't have much of smell. I didn't see any changes texture wise while using this product. My skin overall does better with glycolic acid, so I will continue to use that over this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The toner comes out very slowly and thicker than normal toners (mostly alcohol based and this one doesnt appear so) Leaves your skin slippery/oily until fully dry and then skin feels smooth but almost dry. Does smell good can tell the citrus is there. Has all the fancy ingredients to keep skin younger longer so cant be too bad.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. My skin is generally on the dry side and I typically use moisturizing products to avoid my face feeling tight. This toner definitely made my skin feel smoother and did not dry out my face. I do feel a tingling sensation upon application but it's very temporary (a couple of seconds). It absorbed into my face quickly. I didn't see any significant/visible changes to my pores, but like I said, my skin is definitely smoother. I did have a couple of pimples during my first week of use but that's common for me when I first start using a new product. If you have a similar effect, I recommend starting this toner at a time when you don't have an important event. The scent is clean and not offensive and the bottle is a great value for the size and you need to use very little for the application.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Once over 40, I found it essential to use exfoliants for a smoother and even skin tone. This toner is more potent than other toners I've tried and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin and gently conditions it into looking brighter with more even complexion. It helped me lighten up my sun spots and remove some redness. My skin feels softer and plumper to the touch. It has a slightly thicker consistency that of a serum. I can get away with just using my hands to apply it. I don't have to buy cotton pads anymore. I always layer it with a moisturizer to avoid my skin feeling tight.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this toner from Ole Henriksen. It feels good on the skin when applying. I feel like the bottle size is pretty generous. I do think it has helped with the texture of my skin, it is definitely smoother. I have not noticed any change in discoloration or dark spots.

extraits.titre: Perfect for your summer skincare routine.
extraits.texte: I have normal skin, and I can honestly say I felt this toner give my skin the life it needs. The product did a wonderful job improving my texture and helping dissolve any dark spots. You could definitely see the exfoliation after the first use. It has a very subtle scent I didn't find overwhelming. This toner is extremely gentle and doesn't strip away any of my natural barrier. My skin felt so rejuvenated. To find a product that brings a fresh feeling to your face during the summer is unmatched. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

extraits.titre: Feels really nice and definitely works
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It definitely works! I have a lot of acne scarring, skin discoloration and the start of wrinkles (I am in my thirties) and I think it brightened and toned up after using this for over a month. It's a nice big bottle and honestly sometimes toner smells iffy but this one smells very fresh and maybe a little fruity. It absorbs very quickly, in one of these attached photos I have just applied it and it's barely noticeable. I would love to see its effects after another few months of use.
